summary: Implemented the Admin banners, banner creation and preview, localized tips, and homepage section administration surfaces for ADM-46 through ADM-49. The UI consumes the implemented banner and CMS contracts, keeps banner ordering placement-scoped, preserves optimistic versions and sensitive change reasons, renders safe loading/empty/error/retry/permission/success states, and supports Arabic RTL plus English and Simplified Chinese LTR on the approved Admin Desktop scope.

scopeNotes: Admin Dashboard scope is approved Desktop-only; Arabic is RTL and English/Simplified Chinese are LTR. Tablet/mobile Admin projects were not claimed.

apps/web/src/features/frontend_foundation/app.tsx was modified outside the selected task Allowed Roots solely to wire ADM-46 through ADM-49 into the existing runtime shell; no unrelated route behavior was changed.
Banner reordering is placement-scoped to the server contract and preserves other placement groups in the client projection.
The banner contract does not provide per-record availableActions; API authentication, authorization, validation, versions, and safe error projections remain authoritative.
The UI does not hardcode a universal advertising price, does not expose storage keys or permanent private URLs, and does not imply automatic bank verification.
Backend CMS runtime truth repair backend_038 was completed as a separate authorized prerequisite before this task; no Backend runtime code was changed for frontend_072.
